infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Findr uses your approximate location to show people nearby. Exact GPS is never shown on your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Findr uses your photo library so you can set a profile picture. Photos upload to Findr only and are not saved back to your gallery.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Findr uses your approximate location to show people nearby. Exact GPS is never shown on your profile.

plugins.photosPermission: Findr uses your photo library so you can set a profile picture. Photos upload to Findr only and are not saved back to your gallery.

plugins.cameraPermission: Findr uses an in-app camera for photos and short videos (max 30 seconds). Media stays in Findr only — not your phone gallery.
plugins.microphonePermission: Findr uses the microphone for short in-app videos (max 30 seconds). Nothing is saved to your phone gallery.
